testsuite.name: org.mozilla.fenix.lw.DohProviderMigrationTest

testcase.name: the migration runs once, so a later explicit choice is respected
the provider is written under the key Settings reads, in the edit that sets the flags
a recreated activity shows the notice again
a stored but inactive Mullvad provider is replaced without a notice
a Mullvad provider in use is replaced, the mode is kept and the notice is queued
the notice is shown once per activity and only cleared by the user
